text:
Thus, as if playing, I brought my heart near you

Long ago, in a spring...

But you, indifferent, passed by my side...

Long ago.


Wise in all things, perhaps you did not know

That girl's game that discreetly covered

With innocent laughter the tremendous secret,

Wise in all things...


Today, returned to my side, already a woman, you ask me

For that heart that in silence was yours,

And with clumsy negative words I argue

Today, returned to my side.


Oh, when I offered you my heart in that

Spring, the heart was a sweet untouched cluster...

Already others have tasted the grapes

Of the innocent cluster...

translation.title: The Innocent Cluster
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the grape-cluster metaphor and the repeated temporal returns.
